question: A conducting rod of length $l$ moves with velocity $v$ perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field $B$. The motional EMF induced across the ends of the rod is due to:

options.A: The change in self-inductance of the rod.
options.B: The Lorentz force acting on the free electrons inside the rod.
options.C: The electric field created by the external magnet.
options.D: The heating effect of the current.
